intended_reader: B2B AI implementation recruiter / founder / delivery lead

decision.problem: Unstructured B2B requests require a service category and urgency; a working model alone does not establish useful triage.
decision.initial_framing: Pick whichever single approach (LLM or keyword rules) has higher aggregate accuracy.
decision.hypothesis: Assign validated category extraction to the LLM, keyword urgency to deterministic rules and use a separate policy to review disagreement.
alternatives: Hybrid category/rule urgency with explicit conflict review
decision.strongest_counterexample: Rules urgency misses 5 of 9 high-labeled scenarios despite better overall urgency accuracy; missed critical work may cost more than false alarms.
decision.choice: Implement hybrid as a bounded experiment; source-attribute decisions, fail closed on conflicts and preserve separate simulated approval.
decision.falsifier: Reject or revise the hypothesis if prospective independent cases or client-weighted loss, SLA risk or review capacity make hybrid worse than feasible alternatives.
decision.stop_rule: After the decision is explained, counterexample tested, bounded code checked and exact-head CI verified, stop the synthetic demonstration. Resume only on new independent evidence or a paying customer's real requirements.

economics.meaning: Missed-high cost divided by false-high cost for hybrid vs LLM, conditional on equal category costs and LLM calls, ignoring review and operating costs.

provenance.operator: Project owner proposed component-level routing and insisted on falsification, independent n and economic value rather than a cosmetic portfolio.
provenance.ai_assistance: Assistant calculated contrasts, challenged the missed-high failure mode, implemented/tests/documented the bounded experimental policy.
provenance.subject: Research/engineering work sample; no applicant-cohort comparison or personal IQ inference.
